Example 1

This rabbit was sitting next to a rabbit hole. When my dog barked, [out went|^down went] the rabbit, followed closely by my dog.

Example 2

The demonstrators are starting to advance on the parliament building, but [come here|^here come] the police to prevent them getting any nearer.

question.text: The starter fired his pistol, and [here went|^away went] the runners.
question.modelAnswerString: The starter fired his pistol, and away went the runners.

question.text: The other day I was sitting in the park reading the newspaper, when [^up came|came up] this policeman and ordered me to leave.
question.modelAnswerString: The other day I was sitting in the park reading the newspaper, when up came this policeman and ordered me to leave.

question.text: [Go there|^There go] Hugo Morales and his girlfriend. Did you know they're getting married?
question.modelAnswerString: There go Hugo Morales and his girlfriend. Did you know they're getting married?

question.text: When CDs came onto the market they were incredibly popular, but then [^along came|along went] music downloads and no one buys CDs any more.
question.modelAnswerString: When CDs came onto the market they were incredibly popular, but then along came music downloads and no one buys CDs any more.

question.text: I'm so hungry ... Oh, good. [^Here comes|There goes] breakfast.
question.modelAnswerString: I'm so hungry ... Oh, good. Here comes breakfast.

question.text: I was crossing the bridge when there was a sudden gust of wind and [^away flew|flew away] my hat.
question.modelAnswerString: I was crossing the bridge when there was a sudden gust of wind and away flew my hat.

question.text: I opened my bedroom window last night and [^in flew|there flew] this big bat.
question.modelAnswerString: I opened my bedroom window last night and in flew this big bat.

question.text: When Mr Napier took over the company, [along came|^out went] all the old computers and new ones were bought.
question.modelAnswerString: When Mr Napier took over the company, out went all the old computers and new ones were bought.

question.text: [^There goes|Here goes] the doorbell again. Can you get it this time?
question.modelAnswerString: There goes the doorbell again. Can you get it this time?

question.text: I sent off my membership form, and [^back came|back went] my first monthly magazine.
question.modelAnswerString: I sent off my membership form, and back came my first monthly magazine.
